title: The Table Is Set
label: ch:gu-table-is-set
canDo: I can hear and say five everyday Gujarati food words, and read and write one of them.

payoff.summary: Five food words enter meaning-first by ear, one lesson each; an oral checkpoint scores listening and speaking apart, rice reaches the page with signs taught before chapter 8, and an R1 return carries the chapter-16 table back at its fourth spacing window.
